headline: Callahan Passage Full Warden as Expanse Gunfire Eases
war_summary: Since the 09:15 filing Callahan's Passage has returned to full Warden holding at ten, with three changes in the last two hours and twenty-nine on the day about Crumbling Post and The Crumbling Passage, alongside twenty-four-hour losses of 10,859 Colonial and 11,728 Warden. The Weathered Expanse and Palantine Berm have gone quiet in the last two hours after morning activity, the Expanse holding one Warden, six Colonial and two unheld with sixty-one changes on the day about Crow's Nest, Wightwalk and Shattered Advance, and the Berm holding seven Warden with fifty-one on the day about The Droll and The Pippeli Stones, both wires last moving at 08:46. Stlican Shelf remains active with two changes in two hours and twenty-five on the day about Breaker Town and Port of Rime, last moving at 11:44. Stonecradle is quiet in the last two hours with eleven on the day about The Reach. The Nevish Line reports no changes in two hours but shows sharp casualty rates.
